generation: all raw occurrence, operation and semantic identities recorded
trusted_raw: validator receives a generator-held snapshot separate from the certificate and recomputes each occurrence, duplicate and canonical representative
exact_duplicate: proof-safe merge only after full downstream-semantic comparison with canonical order-independent representative
operation_equivalence: not sufficient for merge; different action ID/model remains distinct
candidate_router: rank is called only after frozen-proof, remove/add mapping, finite solve, exact SVD rank/dof/condition/state-step and shape preconditions; unknown/boundary cases and catchable rank exceptions use router-local raw-H SVD dense exact, then continue through postcondition/census; dense-invalid remains fail closed
risk_selection: no complete ledger or winner claim
commit: commit_allowed=false; hardware-barrier best-effort path also discards
exception: explicit ABI-stable external generator-to-census sidecar duplicates one actual generated raw occurrence, then explicit throwing dependencies on the production RealtimeIntegrityPipeline candidate/post/PL calls preserve both pre-staged occurrence rows and the reason-code certificate through outer catch; generated=2, planned=1, omitted exact duplicate=1, and actual 0/0/0, 1/0/0, 1/1/0 stage counts remain distinguishable; lastAttempt, final packet, integrity.csv and every candidates.csv occurrence row agree
release_environment: NDEBUG legacy P006 environment variable values cannot change raw census, decision fields or final packet
csv: fde_status/reason codes and every occurrence/operation/semantic/reason/duplicate-of identity retained
ros: production adapter copies fde_status, reason, reason_codes and final protection flags
